From 69acc488aaf39d0ddf6c3cf0e47c1873d39919a2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Srinivas Kandagatla <srinivas.kandagatla@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 08:11:09 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: qcom: q6apm-lpass-dai: Fix multiple graph opens

As prepare can be called mulitple times, this can result in multiple
graph opens for playback path.

This will result in a memory leaks, fix this by adding a check before
opening.

Fixes: be1fae62cf25 ("ASoC: q6apm-lpass-dai: close graph on prepare errors")
Cc: Stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Srinivas Kandagatla <srinivas.kandagatla@oss.qualcomm.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260402081118.348071-5-srinivas.kandagatla@oss.qualcomm.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/qcom/qdsp6/q6apm-lpass-dais.c b/sound/soc/qcom/qdsp6/q6apm-lpass-dais.c
index 5be37eeea329..ba64117b8cfe 100644
--- a/sound/soc/qcom/qdsp6/q6apm-lpass-dais.c
+++ b/sound/soc/qcom/qdsp6/q6apm-lpass-dais.c
@@ -181,7 +181,7 @@ static int q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare(struct snd_pcm_substream *substream, struct s
 	 * It is recommend to load DSP with source graph first and then sink
 	 * graph, so sequence for playback and capture will be different
 	 */
-	if (substream->stream == SNDRV_PCM_STREAM_PLAYBACK) {
+	if (substream->stream == SNDRV_PCM_STREAM_PLAYBACK && dai_data->graph[dai->id] == NULL) {
 		graph = q6apm_graph_open(dai->dev, NULL, dai->dev, graph_id);
 		if (IS_ERR(graph)) {
 			dev_err(dai->dev, "Failed to open graph (%d)\n", graph_id);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File: `sound/soc/qcom/qdsp6/q6apm-lpass-dais.c`

**Modifications**:
- In the `q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare` function, a guard condition was added to the playback path.
- Previously, for a playback stream (`SNDRV_PCM_STREAM_PLAYBACK`), `q6apm_graph_open()` was called unconditionally on every prepare.
- The patch adds an additional check: `&& dai_data->graph[dai->id] == NULL`.  
  This ensures the graph is opened only if it hasn't been opened already for that specific DAI.

**Purpose**:
- Prevents multiple calls to `q6apm_graph_open()` when `prepare` is invoked multiple times (as allowed by the ALSA framework).
- Avoids memory leaks and resource mismanagement caused by duplicate graph opens.

### Relationship Between Modifications
- This is a single, self-contained change in one file.  
- There are no cross-file dependencies; the fix is localized to the conditional logic within the `prepare` callback of the Q6APM LPASS DAI driver.
